messages:
Elaine (Events): Quick check — rehearsal today 2pm PT. final run-through checklist: mics, slides, captions, recording name/path. please confirm availability.
Manny (Growth): In for 2pm. I'll QA the landing page UTM and registration confirmation copy.
Olivia (Content): I'll do a 5-min dry run of slides with the speakers at 1:45. Can someone confirm the speaker bio blurbs are in the page?
Elaine (Events): @Olivia yes I uploaded bios to the event Notion. Also note legal wants consent language for recording on the reg page: "By registering you agree to be recorded."
Sam (Ops): Zoom config reminders: enable 'Record to the cloud' (we'll export VTT), enable closed captions + live transcript, disable participant screen share by default, restrict join before host. Recording naming convention: `webinar_{YYYYMMDD}_redwood_{shorttopic}_rec`. Upload path: `gdrive/Events/Recordings/2026/`.
Manny (Growth): UTM examples for registration links: `?utm_source=email&utm_medium=org_email&utm_campaign=redwood-webinar-2026-launch`. Please don't change the utm_campaign string — it's tied to the SFDC routing.
Olivia (Content): Post-event assets plan: 1) Recording (trim intro) 2) Transcript (VTT -> cleaned) 3) Short clips (30–60s) for socials 4) Blog/benchmark piece by next Tue. Can we auto-send transcript to Notion page?
Sam (Ops): Zoom -> Otter.ai integration will auto-create transcript VTT. I'll add a Zap to copy VTT to our drive and notify #marketing when ready. Also giving ops steps to convert VTT to clean text: `ffmpeg -i input.vtt -vn -acodec copy` (we'll run small cleanup script after).
Jules (Sales): How will leads flow to Sales? Need mapping: webinar leads -> SFDC Campaign "Webinar Launch April 2026"; assign owner rule: MQLs from enterprise domains -> AE queue. Manny can you confirm?
Manny (Growth): Confirmed. I'll set the Zapier mapping: form -> HubSpot -> SFDC. Also tag `source:webinar` and `topic:inference-ops` so we can segment follow-ups.
Elaine (Events): Follow-up cadence draft: immediate email within 1 hour with recording + TL;DR + CTA (book demo), 48hr follow-up with benchmark doc, 7-day personalized outreach for engaged accounts. Sam add a note: only include recording link if attendee consented.
Sam (Ops): noted. We'll check the registration opt-in field and filter before sending.
ZoomBot: Recording started for webinar_20260415_redwood_inference_rec (automatic). :record_button:
Olivia (Content): Two quick asks before rehearsal: 1) can we add editable timestamps to the recording upload (so prod can clip easily)? 2) please confirm video intro frame (logo + 5s) added to the video file name pattern.
Elaine (Events): Yes to both. @Sam can you ensure the upload includes a companion `.timestamps.txt` file with speaker segments?
Sam (Ops): Yep — I'll include `webinar_YYYYMMDD_meta.json` and `webinar_YYYYMMDD_timestamps.txt` on upload. File permissions: marketing-team edit, events read.
Manny (Growth): I'll prepare the immediate email template (subject + 1-sentence TL;DR + CTA). Olivia will draft benchmark link copy.
Olivia (Content): On it. I'll also export short 45s clips for LinkedIn and Twitter. Who's approving social drafts? @Manny?
Manny (Growth): Approve from growth side. @Elaine final sign-off for event assets.
Elaine (Events): Sounds good. Final note for rehearsal: speakers please join 15 min early, use wired ethernet if possible, and mute notifications. See you at 2pm. :white_check_mark:
